verdict.rationale: LibreChat is self-hosted and can be installed via Docker Compose, npm, or Helm, so a user could stand up a separate local instance for testing. Its code interpreter claims secure code execution, which suggests isolated code runs. Neither amounts to a documented sandbox or test-environment feature for keeping experiments away from production data. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging mode, guidance on isolating test data from production, data-separation guarantees for agent/tool testing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
